MCPay and MCPay x402 are both open-source infrastructures designed to integrate on-chain payments into Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, enabling AI agents to perform pay-per-call transactions. They utilize the x402 "Payment Required" protocol to facilitate these payments. ([docs.mcpay.tech](https://docs.mcpay.tech/?utm_source=openai))

**MCPay** provides a comprehensive SDK that supports both Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) and Solana networks. It offers a non-intrusive middleware solution, allowing developers to monetize their tools by setting per-call, per-token, or dynamic pricing. MCPay handles the entire payment lifecycle, including accepting and verifying on-chain payments, and automatically retries the original MCP request once confirmed. ([docs.mcpay.tech](https://docs.mcpay.tech/?utm_source=openai))

**MCPay x402**, as detailed in the x402 documentation, focuses on integrating the x402 protocol into MCP servers.
